chunks: God does accept repentance, but only of those who are guilty of an evil out of ignorance yet quickly repent, and God turns to them again, for God is all-knowing and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for God's acceptance of repentance according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often contrasted with the subsequent verse (4:18) to distinguish between 'early' repentance (before death or the rising of the sun from the west) and 'late' repentance. It highlights that divine acceptance is linked to the sincerity and timeliness of the return to God, reflecting His attribute of Al-Hakim (The Wise) in judging the heart's state. This underscores the Shia emphasis on proactive spiritual preparation rather than relying on last-minute absolution.
